sentences.text: It has been alleged, investments sought from the public were usurped in the name of the corporation Lok Hit Nidhi Company Limited.
The present petitioner acted solely as an agent merely collecting money from the public and depositing it with that corporation.
Thus, it has been asserted, the petitioner is not a beneficiary and, therefore, he is not complicit in any offence, if any.
5. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. would submit that all factual grounds being raised by the petitioner may not be acted upon, at this stage, as the investigation is still going on.
The specific role of individuals involved is yet to be fully ascertained.
Learned A.G.A. has also pointed out that statutory remedies are available to the petitioner.
6. In view of the above, we are not inclined to exercise our extraordinary jurisdiction under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, at this stage.
Therefore, petitioner is at liberty to avail the appropriate remedy in accordance with the law.
Also, it is expected that the Investigating Officer will act mindful of the law, particularly with respect to arrest procedures.
7. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
